label: start
name: starting architecture
last_analysis: All 9 trials scored exactly 0, in training as well as on dev. That includes recipe sweeps over epochs, entropy, lr and gamma, a deeper trunk, a per-layer network, a dihedral gate and a dense action remap. If the world matched its description, a 1x1 policy that places bricks on target cells at the landing layer should learn quickly and build some small designs exactly. A hard zero everywhere therefore points to a mismatch between the network's outputs and the env's action layout, not to capacity or recipe. Ruled out so far: flips and transpositions with type-major order and DONE last, and per-type anchor or footprint offsets, which the 3x3 heads covered. Not yet tested: other orderings of the type/y/x axes in the action index (for example type-minor), and DONE sitting at index 0. If DONE sits at index 0, the agent can never stop, so success is impossible. This last round covers these with cheap output-side gates plus a per-action global term, and adds a layout-free attention head as a hedge.
